newsitem.title: UK: Britannia B/S lifts borrowing, savings rates.
newsitem.headline: Britannia B/S lifts borrowing, savings rates.

text.p: The Britannia Building Society BRI.CN said on Tuesday it had raised its borrowing and savings rates following the 0.25 point rise in UK base rates to 6.25 percent last week.
The Britannia said it had raised its standard variable mortgage lending rate by 0.35 point to 7.60 percent. The rise takes effect from today for new borrowers and from June 1 for existing borrowers.
The Society said it will also launch a new range of savings products and will increase the rate it pays on its Capital Trust postal account by over half a point on average.
Britannia, with assets of more than 16 billion stg, is committed to remaining mutually owned.

Britannia director Gerald Gregory said the latest round of mortgage rate increases would not have a serious impact on the housing market as its latest survey of market confidence had shown "housing market expectancy" had risen for the fourth consecutive quarter.
